messages:
olivia: Heads-up: several tenants reporting console usage charts stopped updating around 03:00 UTC. Hourly aggregates for many tenants are ~6 hours behind. Customers started filing tickets. Can we triage?

support-bot: Alert: hourly_rollup_failure rate spike detected for service=analytics at 2109876500. See /ops/alerts/HR-430 :eyes:

micaela: looking. which tenants affected? quick check — run this for a tenant: 
```
SELECT tenant_id, max(hour) as last_hour
FROM usage_hourly
WHERE tenant_id = 'acme'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
```

jia: seeing consumer lag on kafka for group=usage-aggregator-01. sample output:
```
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
raw_events      0          12459123        12478190        19067
raw_events      1          12458990        12478400        19410
```
Also some OFFSET_RESET events during the 03:00 UTC migration window.

max: we rolled a schema change to raw_events partitioning at 02:58 UTC. I suspect the consumer group rebalance + reset produced duplicate processing attempts and stalled commits. Will investigate aggregator logs for commit exceptions.

darren: started a rolling restart of usage-aggregator-01 on lane-3 and lane-4 to force rejoin and resume commits. commands:
```
sudo systemctl restart redwood-usage-aggregator@lane-3
sudo systemctl restart redwood-usage-aggregator@lane-4
```
Pausing scheduled hourly_rollup jobs for the window to avoid dup counts.

olivia: two paying tenants (acme, orbitex) have open tickets asking for ETA and whether data loss occurred. Can we provide a safe ETA?

support-ops: temporary mitigation — you can trigger a manual rollup for a tenant while we clear the consumer backlog. Use admin API:
```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/admin/run_rollup" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","hours_back":6}'
```
Note: only run after we confirm consumer offsets won't replay the same window (risk of double-counting).

max: important: do NOT run manual rollups AND run the replay at the same time. Plan: 1) pause rollups, 2) replay consumer offsets to catch up, 3) validate counts vs raw_events snapshot, 4) unpause and run a single manual rollup if necessary.

jia: consumer lag trending down after restarts — overall lag dropped from ~1.2M to ~220k messages in 12 minutes. Running replay from offset 12458000 -> 12478450. ETA ~35-50m depending on consumer throughput. Monitoring consumer lag metric: https://grafana.internal/d/analytics/consumer-lag?orgId=1 :eyes:

darren: logs show commit exceptions cleared after restart. no new ERRORs in aggregator stdout since 2109877200. pushing handler that tightens commit backoff for safety.

olivia: messaging for customers:
"We're investigating a delay in usage metrics ingestion caused by a consumer rebalance during a schema migration. We're replaying messages and expect dashboards to be caught up within 1 hour. No data loss is expected — we'll confirm once counts reconcile."

support-ops: repro notes for postmortem:
- migration timeline
- consumer group offsets and rejoin logs
- kafka broker metrics (ISR, controller events)
- SQL rollup job logs
- steps we ran to recover (restart, pause rollups, replay offsets)

max: filing ENG-PLAT-5321 to track follow-up: add stronger consumer migration path and safe migration checklist. Attaching offsets dump and validation queries as artifacts.

olivia: updated acme & orbitex with ETA ~1hr and suggested workaround (export raw usage CSV from API). Will follow up when everything reconciles. :white_check_mark:
